_why: 육아 트랙 클립 요청. 🚨 아기가 프레임에 보이는 요청은 전부 kind=still — Flow(Veo) 미성년자 안전필터를 안 타려고 미드저니 스틸 한 장만 받고 푸시인·점등은 scripts/make_part_clip.py가 입힌다. 사물과 성인 손만 나오는 비접촉 동작만 Flow로 보낸다. 기전 클립 한 종(m_antibody_neutralization)도 여기 있다 — 항체 주사 구간이 이 편에만 있어서 _shared로 올리지 않았다.

requests.why: `--for 콧물`·`코막힘`은 전부 기전·부위(m_mucus_overproduction, part_nose_sinus)로만 나오고 행위는 act_cover_face(두 손으로 얼굴을 감싸 쥐는 괴로움 컷)와 act_open_window(창을 열고 코~기관지 통로가 켜지는 환기 컷)뿐이다. 둘 다 코에 무언가를 '넣어 주는' 동작이 아니라 증상을 호소하거나 실내 공기를 바꾸는 장면이다. 이 편의 실천이 '수유 전에 생리식염수로 콧물을 빼준다'여서 병을 쥐고 한 방울씩 떨어뜨리는 손이 필요한데, 아기 코가 프레임에 들어오면 Flow 안전필터를 타므로 방울이 화면 아래 빈 공간으로 떨어지는 사물 단독 컷으로 잡는다.

requests.flow: One continuous shot in a single unbroken scene with no scene cuts. Only one translucent glass hand and a small blank squeeze bottle are ever in frame — no face, no head, no body, nothing beneath the nozzle, and nothing else enters the frame at any point. Nothing anywhere glows, lights up or turns amber at any moment; the hand, the bottle and the fluid all stay the same soft pale cyan from the first frame to the last. 0-1.5s: from the very first frame the hand rolls the bottle over nozzle-down and the thumb and two fingers settle onto its soft sides, and the camera pushes in and tilts down until the nozzle tip sits in the upper half of the frame with empty void under it. 1.5-3s: the fingers press in one short slow squeeze and a single pale drop swells at the nozzle tip, hangs there a beat, then falls straight down and out of the bottom of the frame. 3-4.5s: the fingers release and the soft sides spring back with a faint dimple, and after a clear pause a second drop forms and falls exactly the same way — one squeeze, one drop, one pause, never a stream. 4.5-6s: a third drop swells and the wrist tilts the bottle a few degrees so that drop falls just off to one side, then the hand holds the bottle dead still with a fresh bead of clear fluid hanging at the tip until the very last frame, the dark slate blue-grey void staying empty. The hand stays translucent glass with the finger bones visible inside throughout. No text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no arrows anywhere in the frame; nothing in the frame carries printed markings of any kind. The audio is a low synth drone with a soft squeeze and one faint drip on each drop, no music, no dialogue.

requests.name: m_antibody_neutralization
requests.why: 이 구간의 논지가 '영유아용은 백신이 아니라 이미 만들어진 항체를 넣는 니르세비맙 주사'인데, 신규 요청 중 m_immune_sensitization은 세포가 항원을 삼켜 Y자 항체를 스스로 만들어 세우는 장면이라 이 편이 바로 아니라고 말하는 백신 원리를 그리게 된다(순서가 반대다). m_virus_replication은 막을 것이 없어 증식하는 반대 상황이고, m_immune_decline은 면역세포가 밀리는 노화 컷, m_drug_absorption은 농도가 올랐다 다시 내려오는 경구약 곡선이라 '한 번 맞고 유행철을 버틴다'와 어긋난다. 들어온 항체가 바이러스 돌기를 덮어 세포에 못 붙게 막는 장면이 색인 115종·신규 13종 어디에도 없다.

requests.flow: Three quick shots cut together, about 1.3 seconds each. Shot 1 (0-1.3s): the drifting cloud of pale cyan Y-shaped structures sweeps across the open space and swarms around the spiky warm amber particles, slow push-in. Shot 2 (1.3-2.7s): cut to an extreme close-up of one amber particle as Y-shaped structures clamp onto its spikes one after another, each Y capping a spike until the particle is completely wrapped in a pale cyan cage and its amber glow dims behind it. Shot 3 (2.7-4s): cut to a wide view of the cell sheet below as the caged particles drift down, bump against the pale cyan docking knobs on the cell surface, fail to hold and slide away sideways out of frame, leaving the cell sheet untouched and evenly pale cyan. Keep the exact same translucent pale cyan glass tissue style and dark slate blue-grey void in all three shots; only the virus particles glow warm amber, and they dim as they are capped — the Y-shaped structures, the cells and the docking knobs stay pale cyan glass throughout. No human figure, no body, no face anywhere in the frame. No text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no arrows anywhere in the frame. The audio is a low synth drone with a soft swarming rustle, small clicks as each spike is capped, and two dull muffled taps as the particles bounce off, no music, no dialogue.
